headline: Google DeepMind announces Genie 4 as a multimodal, real-time interactive world-model research preview
summary: Google DeepMind announced Genie 4 on Oct 27, 2026 and said a research preview had begun for trusted testers, with initial access through Project Genie for Google AI Ultra subscribers and early-access partners of the Gemini API and Google AI Studio. The company describes real-time natural-language scene changes, generated audio and dialogue, and qualitative tester exploration across creative, historical, game-design and simulation workflows. These remain first-party, unquantified accounts. DeepMind says visual detail and object permanence can drift over longer sessions, after complex edits or during navigation; physical interactions, audio accuracy, legible text, spatial accuracy and long-term consistency remain active research areas. No benchmark protocol, model card, public code, independent evaluation or measured downstream outcome was inspected.
